news.text: #JUVE, ZERO PENALTIESEleven matches without a penalty in their favor. Among the top teams, #Roma is also drawing a blank, one given to #Como, 2 to the Milanese clubs and 3 to #Lazio. #Yildiz is ready for his return: "I'll be back in December". Injury for #Kalulu: he will be out for a month.[Front Page Corriere dello Sport]

#YILDIZ: "#JUVE, I'M COMING"The Turk: "Yes, I am returning in December. How much I miss my team".Kenan in Bologna receives the Bulgarelli Award and confirms his progress in training at la Continassa, which he will now intensify: "I feel good and I am very homesick". Capello: "He is the Italian Lamine #Yamal". #Spalletti has already called a meeting at 8 AM with his staff and the remaining players to study their mistakes. Meanwhile #Kalulu also faces a muscular layoff: will he be back for #Como?[Front Page TuttoSport]

🔛🧐 "#Juventus will be present on the mercato and will have to evaluate various situations. The number and type of operations will depend on the team's condition heading into January, taking into account injuries and performances. One topic already evaluated by the management relates to the attack: some assessments are already underway. It will be necessary to understand the needs and, at the same time, any potential exits."[Fabrizio Romano - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

👀 "#Juventus's Edon #Zhegrova is currently not very happy with his situation.When called upon, not always but several times, he showed that he can step onto the pitch and provide a significant helping hand to #Juve.It is a situation that needs to be monitored closely.At the start of the season, #Juve considered him practically out of the project.They would have sold him to #AlIttihad at the beginning of September, but it was the Saudi club that ultimately decided to pursue other players."[@FabrizioRomano on YouTube via @PuebloJ]

🤷‍♂️ "Despite having drawn in Florence and the inconsistency shown from one international break to another, the #Juventus management is not questioning the continuity of Luciano #Spalletti, meaning he remains in his position during the break and over the coming weeks."[@FabrizioRomano on YouTube via @PuebloJ]

🚑 #Juventus aims to recover Francisco #Conceição, Nico #González and Andrea #Cambiaso for the match against #Venezia.The international break will serve to work on their recovery at la Continassa.THE THERE PLAYERS▪️ #Conceição is sidelined due to a shoulder issue he suffered in the match against #Lazio▫️ Nico #González was injured after the match against #Rennes ▪️ #Cambiaso pulled up during the match against #AZAlkmaarThe medical staff will monitor their conditions with the hope of gradually reintegrating them into the squad.[@SkySport via @TUTTOJUVE_COM - @PuebloJ]

📊 #Juventus has not had a single penalty in their favor in Serie A and leads the ranking for posts and crossbars.After 11 matchdays, they are the last in terms of penalties received.POSTS AND CROSSBARSIn total, there were 75 balls that hit the woodwork in the first 11 matchdays of Serie A:▪️ #Juventus and #Inter: 8▫️ #Roma: 7▪️ #Como and #Fiorentina: 6#Udinese is the only team that has not hit the post or crossbar yet.Nico #González and Francisco #Conceição are among the 11 players who hit the woodwork twice each.THE STANDINGSThe bianconeri are in seventh place, six points away from a Champions League spot.[@tuttosport via @PuebloJ]

🆙💪 After a complicated start to the season, #KoloMuani seems to have finally unlocked himself, also taking on a leadership role within the team. For #Spalletti, however, the defensive problem remains to be solved: while the attack seems to have found its identity, the backline continues to show too many frailties and distractions. The break comes at the right time to reflect and work.[TuttoSport via @juventusinsidernews]

🏆 🇮🇹 To Win the Serie A:🇮🇹 Inter - 49%🇮🇹 AS Roma - 20%🇮🇹 Como - 11%🇮🇹 Lazio - 9%🇮🇹 AC Milan - 6%🇮🇹 Juventus - 3%🇮🇹 Others - 2%👑 🇮🇹 Inter are predicted to win the title by finishing the season with 7 points more than AS Roma.[FootRankings]

THE BIANCONERI CALLED UP BY THEIR NATIONAL TEAMSTen Men’s First Team players have been called up by their respective national teams for the upcoming international matches in mid-November.THE BIANCONERI CALLED UP FOR INTERNATIONAL DUTYKerim Alajbegovic (Bosnia and Herzegovina)Juan Cabal and Jhon Lucumi (Colombia)Zeki Celik (Turkey)Federico Gatti and Guglielmo Vicario (Italy)Jeff Ekhator (Italy U21)Teun Koopmeiners (Netherlands) Weston McKennie (USA)Pape Matar Sarr (Senegal)Edon Zhegrova (Kosovo)[Juventus]

Medical Update | Pierre KaluluAt the end of the match against Fiorentina, Pierre Kalulu reported muscle discomfort in his left thigh and underwent diagnostic tests this morning.The scans carried out at J|medical revealed a low-grade injury to his left biceps femoris. The player has begun treatment, in consultation with the French national team staff, who have withdrawn him from the squad.[Juventus]
